entities.summary: Roberto "Robbie" Orendain Gaa is a Filipino Catholic prelate currently serving as the bishop of the Diocese of Novaliches. He was appointed by Pope Francis on June 6, 2019, and was consecrated as bishop on August 22, 2019.
